description: Feng, Rui-Lin at University of Leeds publishes air-water dynamics measurements from pump ramp-up and ramp-down experiments through Co-UDlabs. The Deltares Beta-loop is a DN 100 PVC pipe system with a 10° or 30° downward-sloping section. Valve changes and air inlet/release devices vary trapped-gas behaviour; temperature, flow, pressure and high-frequency images document the response. Coverage is the Deltares loop facility in the Netherlands; test dates and exact sensor rates are unspecified. Zenodo provides a data ZIP and a PDF test report with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the report describes initial quality checks, not demonstrated performance for all full-scale sewer geometries. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
